snippet.title: Control, I'm Not Coming Back - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515660/Control_Im_Not_Coming_Back/

Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short hopecore-inspired narrative game about a lost astronaut drifting through deep space and encountering Voyager 

Coming out May 29th for free on Steam.
